original_query: select  	s_store_name, 	i_item_desc, 	sc.revenue, 	i_current_price, 	i_wholesale_cost, 	i_brand  from store, item,      (select ss_store_sk, avg(revenue) as ave  	from  	    (select  ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk,  		     sum(ss_sales_price) as revenue  		from store_sales, date_dim  		where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1215 and 1215+11     and ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 22 * 0.01 AND 32 * 0.01  		group by ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) sa  	group by ss_store_sk) sb,      (select  ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, sum(ss_sales_price) as revenue  	from store_sales, date_dim  	where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1215 and 1215+11   and ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 22 * 0.01 AND 32 * 0.01  	group by ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) sc  where sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk and        sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave and        s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk and        i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk        and i_manager_id BETWEEN 16 and 20        and s_state in ('GA','IL','TX')  order by s_store_name, i_item_desc limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH store_item_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        st.s_store_name,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store st
      ON st.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1215 AND 1226
      AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 22 * 0.01 AND 32 * 0.01
      AND st.s_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX')
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, st.s_store_name, ss.ss_item_sk
),
store_item_with_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ss_store_sk,
        s_store_name,
        ss_item_sk,
        revenue,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk) AS ave
    FROM store_item_revenue
)
SELECT
    r.s_store_name,
    i.i_item_desc,
    r.revenue,
    i.i_current_price,
    i.i_wholesale_cost,
    i.i_brand
FROM store_item_with_avg r
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = r.ss_item_sk
WHERE r.revenue <= 0.1 * r.ave
  AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 16 AND 20
ORDER BY r.s_store_name, i.i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The two identical derived tables (sa/sc and sb) scan store_sales and date_dim twice. Consolidate them into a single CTE (store_item_revenue) and compute the per-store average from the same CTE using AVG() OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk), eliminating the redundant scan and self-join.
Constant-fold d_month_seq BETWEEN 1215 AND 1215+11 to BETWEEN 1215 AND 1226.

Push the store state filter (s_state IN ('GA','IL','TX')) into the CTE by joining store before aggregation. This is safe because it only restricts which stores are considered and does not change the per-store average for retained stores, while reducing the rows aggregated over store_sales.

Keep the i_manager_id filter after the average computation: pushing it before the aggregation would change the per-store average and break equivalence. Carry s_store_name in the CTE (grouped with the store key) so the outer query avoids a second join to store.
